To the best of our knowledge, we are the only lab in Vietnam comprehensive enough
to run the whole chain in-house: generative AI that designs molecules, molecular
dynamics that tests which ones hold up under the physics, and synthetic chemistry
that actually makes them. That is what lets a result from the bench change a model
the same week, instead of the next grant cycle.

Almost everyone below is a student, and that is the point: the work is theirs. The
groupings are where people spend most of their time, not walls between them.
